name: Clemence Crake
title: Wholesale merchant
core_character_description: The Crake counter on the Tallage is yours and has been for nineteen years: Brede wool bought down to the last fleece, Ombreval cloth sold out along the river and the Lantern Road, credit given open-handed and called in to the very day. You are courteous, unhurried, and without any mercy at all at the end of a term — you will carry a struggling man three seasons and take his shop in the fourth, and you hold that to be fair, and it is. You married a man of no standing, buried him, and put your own name on his children, and the square laughed at you for it; twenty years on you are still making the square pay for that laugh, one contract at a time, and you will die doing it. What you want is the counter standing after you in a hand you can name; what you have begun to do, without once saying why, is look twice at your son Renn's figures, because his promises have got larger and his sleep has got worse. You deal with Dunstan Skell because you must and trust him the length of his own arm, and you keep the notary Odo Trask on a retainer, because a woman who made her own name signs nothing without a witness.
